benchmark.name: custom
benchmark.justification: A private fixture suite (search/edit/aggregate tasks over a small pseudo-repository) used to pilot the framework on HarmonyOS arm64 with the OPS plugin; it is not a public benchmark and makes no public-benchmark claim.
benchmark.dataset: ops-ga local fixture suite v2 (9 tasks: 3 train / 2 gate / 4 test)
benchmark.selectionProtocol: candidates selected on train + tuning gate only; the test split was opened once by validate and never used for selection

environment.dsh: dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 source build @ harness-src/dsh-022rc1, node 26.10.0, HarmonyOS MNT-W72C
environment.opsBaseline: dsh-ops 0.5.0 (npm package) with native worker rebuilt for aarch64-linux-ohos under three OHOS-only adaptations; worker sha256 5ac5a47cee5844c81c0a26336b7b4f7a7c4bc40f27986bdcf4fd66b713d274a2
environment.opsCandidate: winner guidance from candidate.json (no OPS source change)
environment.permission: danger-full-access (host cannot enforce a sandbox; acknowledged, see reproduce.json sandbox)

redaction.method: literal-path redaction (/storage/Users/<user> -> /redacted/home, run dir -> /redacted/run, DSH_HOME -> /redacted/dsh-home), credential-pattern scrub, then automated secret scan; no provider keys or DSH home contents included
